testcase.name: Scenario: Select an available command with the secondary mouse button: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1199:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select an available command with the secondary mouse button ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user right-clicks "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ Then the "2D Sketches" row is highlighted ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ And the target list is empty ✔ When the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the target list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
